# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1534
**EDP: fail closed for unlisted backlog scopes when DB mode is on**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Unlisted scopes silently stay file-authoritative when PF_BACKLOG_DB=on. -> DB mode fail-closed for unlisted scopes; explicit off for legacy file mode.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1534
  prior_decisions : ['BI-PF-1531 DB authority default', 'unlisted scopes stay file mode today']
  existing_path   : ['core/backlog._db_for warns and returns false', 'core/id_allocator delegates to backlog']
  assumptions     : ['Only explicit PF_BACKLOG_DB=off uses files', 'Required scopes remain product_forge and ProductForge-Dashboard']
  divergences     : ['Silent file fallback for unlisted scopes']
  open_questions  : []
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK | aligned | No API shape change | Keep runtime guard only
  AC CHECK | aligned | Four fail-closed ACs | Test all paths
  LANGUAGE CHECK | aligned | Existing Python edits only; no new module | Keep DB logic in Go
  TENANT/RLS CHECK | aligned | Unlisted tenant fails before DB/file access | Fail closed

## Current stage
**blocked at precheck**

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 1.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=a3feb5f3953f)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 5 (BLOCKER 1 / MAJOR 1 / MINOR 2 / NIT 1); dispositions: actioned 5; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | Disposition ACTIONED for the AC-4 evidence finding is not reflected in data: `test_matrix` still lists the identical pytest command for AC-1..AC-4 and `ac_evidence` for all four ACs share one sha (`69dd9c33`) and one artifact (`operator-recovery.md`) — guardrail 13 (distinct executable test or runbook artifact per AC) is still unmet, so AC-4 runbook coverage remains unproven. | ACTIONED | Fixed in BI-PF-1534 spec/design/evidence; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/AC-4.md. |
| 2 | MAJOR | FR-4's `acceptance` is still "Given DB on When unlisted AC-4 path runs Then it fails closed", which does not match AC-4 (tests and runbook cover read/write/delete/ID paths and operator recovery) — guardrail 11 AC/FR one-to-one correspondence remains unsatisfied (only FR-3 was corrected). | ACTIONED | Fixed in BI-PF-1534 spec/design/evidence; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/AC-4.md. |
| 3 | MINOR | Disposition for the observability finding is ACTIONED but `design_pack.observability` still contains only "Structured ... error with scope key; precheck/test evidence" — no metric/counter or alertability for `BACKLOG_DB_SCOPE_UNLISTED` occurrences was added. | ACTIONED | Fixed in BI-PF-1534 spec/design/evidence; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/AC-4.md. |
| 4 | MINOR | `affected_components` still reads `["Not specified."]`; CL-016's separation of prerequisites (BI-PF-1531) from changed components remains only partially actioned (`affected_files` is now populated). | ACTIONED | Fixed in BI-PF-1534 spec/design/evidence; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/AC-4.md. |
| 5 | NIT | FR-1/FR-2/FR-4 `title` values are truncated mid-string ("...raise BACKLOG_DB_SCOPE_U"), weakening traceability readability in the spec pack. | ACTIONED | Fixed in BI-PF-1534 spec/design/evidence; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1534/AC-4.md. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Guardrails on mode completeness (dual/shadow), FR-3/off-mode, security posture, rollback, startup validation, and guardrail checklist items are genuinely addressed in this revision.
  The two blockers/majors that remain are evidence and AC/FR traceability: a single shared evidence artifact + single test command still backs all four ACs, and FR-4's outcome text still does not describe AC-4's test/runbook requirement.
  Gate should not pass until AC-4 has a distinct, executable runbook/recovery artifact reference and FR-4's acceptance is rewritten to match AC-4.
